vpp.plan_summary: 1. Using admitted #299/#304 tooling, bind one issue worktree and create child goal naming ADL #1299 and CodeFriend #120. 2. Agree representative corpus and candidate with operator and inventory reusable evidence. 3. Inspect actual outputs and journeys, recording provenance and limitations. 4. Prioritize only reproduced gaps and map to existing packages. 5. Obtain operator denominator acceptance and independent exact-head review; publish only with actual proof. Stop for missing candidate/evidence, need for unapproved spend, or materially changed scope.
vpp.required_outcome_inline: Review actual outputs and end-to-end journeys on representative repositories; agree a prioritized gap register and measurable Beta 1 acceptance denominator with the operator.
vpp.deliverables_inline: Produce docs/codefriend/beta1/assessment-120/ candidate-and-corpus register, scenario/evidence matrix, prioritized gap register, and operator acceptance decision. Record actual readable reports/exports and login, consent, pairing, first-review, result and recovery journeys from representative repositories. Route accepted gaps to existing #121/#123/#125/#126; do not recreate closed work.
vpp.acceptance_criteria_inline: Each observed case identifies repository revision, candidate components, scenario, expected/actual result and evidence. Each gap has reproduction, impact, priority, acceptance measure and existing follow-on mapping. Label unexercised paths honestly. Operator agrees corpus, measurable denominator and priorities; independent review checks evidence. Reject unreproduced defects and substitution of prior qualification for user acceptance.
vpp.dependencies_inline: ADL #1296 accepted opening; C-SDLC #299 delivered in PR #308 (merge 007f84b4a98ba2c38767f67dadc88a142e1cfa88); use an authenticated admitted owner containing #299 and #304 before execution. Operator selection of representative corpus and candidate is the first assessment step, not a fabricated current acceptance.
vpp.repo_inputs_inline: README.md; docs/codefriend/INSTALLED_CONTENT_JOURNEY.md; current representative report/export artifacts and journey evidence; runtime-dependencies and shared-library-dependencies authenticated manifests; ADL v0.93.2 CodeFriend feature contract; GitHub #120.
vpp.target_files_surfaces_inline: docs/codefriend/beta1/assessment-120/ and issue-local evidence/cards. Product correctness fixes belong to the accepted follow-on issues, not this assessment.
vpp.validation_plan_inline: PVF planning_contract for evidence-led assessment per live issue; product_behavior evidence is required to support actual journey claims. Small deterministic artifact/link/schema checks plus bounded inspection of already available outputs. Record candidate, platform, scenario counts and failed/blocked/skipped lanes separately. No broad rebuild, new paid run or release qualification. Operator acceptance is a required human gate, never automated by git diff. Execution setup: register python3 tools/validate_beta1_assessment.py after authoring it against the operator-agreed records. Check candidate/corpus identity, scenario denominator/status, evidence references, reproduced gaps with existing issue routing, and explicit operator decision. Add focused rejection fixtures. Success marker beta1 assessment evidence complete proves completeness only; independent inspection proves readable output and journey claims.
vpp.non_goals_inline: No deployment, paid provider/cloud calls, Runtime restart, shared binary replacement, downstream implementation, or v0.93.3 activation. Preserve sole-writer ownership. Use the operator-selected worktree destination; FastWork is this machine’s preference, without location-policy enforcement. This session prepares only; later child execution requires accepted dependencies and an assigned owner.
vpp.notes_risks_inline: Prepared design only; dependency readiness is separate. Planning #12 accepted the execution-validator contract; final preparation review follows native card completion. No implementation, product validation, publication, merge or closeout claimed.
vpp.validation_size_split: focused issue lane only; broad release proof out of scope
vpp.issue_goal_ref: Create issue-bound goal for ADL #1299 / codefriend #120 after execution binding; no child goal exists yet.
